'''Malador''' was an overpopulated [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|urban]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]]. [[Cappabellor beetle]]s were [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to Malador, and it served as the homeworld of the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[House Kellermin]]. Over [[Time/Legends|time]], Malador's ecosystem was ruined by industrial pollution, and many House Kellermin nobles left the planet for the nearby world of [[Resti Kel]], leaving [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and client [[Species/Legends|species]] to work in Malador's [[Factory/Legends|factories]].

==Description==
Malador was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Malador system/Legends|Malador system]] of the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Malador lay between the [[Resti Kel system/Legends|Resti Kel]] and [[Zaria system/Legends|Zaria systems]] on the [[Senex-Juvex Loop]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. The [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route known as the [[Kassido Bypass]] linked the planet to the [[Thermon system/Legends|Thermon system]], and another hyperlane connected it to the [[Carsanza system/Legends|Carsanza system]].<ref name="TEA" />

Malador was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to an [[Insect/Legends|insect]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the [[cappabellor beetle]].<ref name="LARP" /> At one point, the planet's nature was considered to be beautiful; however, it eventually became an [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|urbanized world]], and many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of industrial pollution and choking smog ruined its ecosystem.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Malador was one of a number of select worlds whose fauna was showcased in the [[Atrium]], a public building in the [[Ord Mynock Freeport|only spaceport]] on the<ref name="LARP" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Mynockra system]]</ref> planet [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock]].<ref name="LARP" />

==Inhabitants==
Malador was a crowded world that was the homeworld of [[House Kellermin]], one of the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]] of the Senex-Juvex region. Eventually, many of the House Kellermin nobles left Malador for the nearby industrial world of [[Resti Kel]], which had been developed much more carefully than Malador. In the absence of the nobles, House Kellermin [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and members of several client species also inhabited Malador.<ref name="TEA" />

==Locations==
Dismal [[Factory/Legends|factories]] were located on Malador and, following the emigration of local nobles to Resti Kel, were staffed by slaves and members of client species of House Kellermin.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Malador was introduced in ''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]'', a [[West End Games]] sourcebook written by [[Tony Russo|Anthony Russo]] and published in [[1996]].<ref name="LARP" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the planet in grid square L-17.<ref name="TEA" />
